scientific_integrity: Known 2020 scalar connected k-forcing number for friendship graphs is explicitly credited; new assessed claim is all-cardinality enumeration and heterogeneous-blade classification. A direct proof and reproducible independent-from-formula enumeration are included.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple clique bouquets with r>=2, each blade size>=2, integer k>=1. Does not extend to arbitrary block graphs or provide a universal literature-priority guarantee.
title: Connected forcing enumerators of unequal clique windmills
